elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company’s request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided “at HDI’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination, HDI must return all defined Company Data to the Company within 30 days.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Company Data must be returned in a “commonly used, machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, HDI must delete Company Data and certify the deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: HDI must make transition assistance available for up to six months, which exceeds 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination, HDI must return Company Data within 30 days in a commonly used, machine-readable format, constituting the required export.
